latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Tool for Videos — fast, AI-powered video editing and export.

- Upload raw video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and describe desired edits.
- Automated editing with options such as trimming silences, adding captions, and exporting as MP4.
- Simple onboarding: anonymous authentication with 100 free credits, automatic backend setup.
- Clear matching of user prompts to actions (upload, export, check credits, and more).
- Full cloud-based processing with no software to install; most jobs complete in 1–2 minutes.
